body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: e5fcf5886070cd098da118b46fe3fed0738370ad -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Fix matches #948: labels shrink 13 -> 10 px before eliding, the four section doors get distinct short words (full name kept in tip/dropdown), captions are painted again only when they fit their group's span.
- Pinned by `structural::ribbon_labels_whole_and_captions_painted`: at 1280 px no ribbon galley is elided, each of 24 button labels is painted exactly once, and the five captions sit under the cells in left-to-right order. Text and coarse placement only, so it is OS-independent.
- Snapshot PNGs untouched (correct per AGENTS.md); the decision file `docs/decisions/948-ribbon-labels.md` is in the right place; no CHANGELOG edit; no process files, deps, build.rs or .github touched.
- The ground-grid guard (`interact.rs`) closes a real hang on non-finite/huge camera, with a law test; no new unwrap/expect/panic outside tests.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, merge was clean)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=1` | 532 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored (includes both new tests) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `panes.rs` and `painted.rs` growth is small; check they are not already well over ~400 lines when convenient.
- Pixel goldens will differ at the cut, as the body says; regenerate them there after a look at the diffs.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e5fcf5886070cd098da118b46fe3fed0738370ad -->
**Independent review** (second pair of eyes; the PR was only self-reviewed before). Verdict: **Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- Meets #948's Done means: `structural::ribbon_labels_whole_and_captions_painted` asserts no ribbon galley is elided at 1280 px, each of the 24 button labels is painted exactly once (no two buttons share text), and the five captions (File, Setup, Modify, Inspect, View) are painted under the cells, left to right. The decision for the single-door groups skipping captions is recorded in `docs/decisions/948-ribbon-labels.md`.
- Labels are plain English: New, Model, Open, Save, Save As, Post, Setups, Stock, Origin, Tools, Undo, Redo, Run, Delete, Frame, Paths, Simulate, Deviate, Panels..., Theme..., Mill 2D..., Mill 3D..., Drill..., Multi... (full names stay in tips).
- Grid guard (`interact.rs` ground_grid_lines) returns no lines for non-finite / >1e9 target or step; `law_tests::the_ground_grid_survives_a_nan_or_huge_camera` covers NaN, inf, 1e308.
- No snapshot PNG changes, no println/eprintln, layering intact.

Local results (merged with main a6bd69d8, clean merge)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD crates/ui): 533 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (non-blocking)
- The test uses `panic!` for a missing caption (test code, fine). Goldens will differ at the next cut, as the PR says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
